card.name: The digit 5 in ISBNs and citations
card.fires_on: The digit 5 when it starts or sits inside a numeric code. Most often in ISBNs, and also in journal volume numbers and allele numbers.

modes.label: Journal volume numbers

modes.label: Dose or allele numbers
modes.description: The digit 5 in a decimal dose or gene allele name.
